M9 — 2026-10-10
A driven session's Bash runs under the run's surface (run_started.surface): a command outside its allow rules answers 'requires approval', which a -p session cannot grant, so it simply fails. Seen here: git check-ignore, git -C, sed -i and for-loops. In a chained command every part must match a rule. Read files with the Read tool and stick to the listed git verbs.
